headlines.title: What Is Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Showing With Its New Edge AI Subsystem?
headlines.summary: Cadence Design Systems (NasdaqGS:CDNS) and Expedera announced a joint edge AI subsystem integration using Cadence's Tensilica NeuroEdge 130 AI Co-Processor and Expedera's Origin Evolution NPU IP. The partners are showcasing pre-silicon simulation of workload distribution and execution for edge inference use cases. The collaboration is aimed at power efficient AI inference in edge devices where performance and energy use are tightly constrained.

headlines.title: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Launches OrCAD Xplore, Is It Trading At A Discount?
headlines.summary: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) just rolled out its OrCAD Xplore Design Platform, tying component research, design tools, supply chain data and procurement into one connected environment for printed circuit board engineers. Against that backdrop, Cadence Design Systems’ share price has eased 5.5% over the past month but is still up 1.7% over 90 days and 6.1% year to date, while the 1 year total shareholder return sits at 4.4% and the 5 year total shareholder return at 75.4%.

headlines.title: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Stock Could Be Overvalued On Fresh AI Design Platform News
headlines.summary: Cadence Design Systems has delivered a solid long term share price return, and fresh product and partnership updates keep the story moving. The key issue now is whether the current valuation lines up with what the business earns. With the focus squarely on earnings power rather than headline momentum, the question is how much of that earnings profile is already reflected in today's price. Over the past 5 years, Cadence Design Systems has returned 76.

headlines.title: Wall Street Analysts Think Cadence (CDNS) Is a Good Investment: Is It?
headlines.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Cadence (CDNS) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

description: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. develops computational, AI-driven software, hardware, and silicon intellectual property products and solutions. The company offers functional verification services, such as Jasper, a formal verification platform; Xcelium, a parallel logic simulation platform; Verisium, a generative AI solution; Palladium, an enterprise emulation platform; and Protium, a prototyping platform for chip verification, as well as digital IC design and sign off products, including Innovus platform; and custom IC design and simulation product include Virtuoso, a platform to design and verify analog. It also provides Xcelium logic simulator and other front-end verification and virtual prototyping technologies; controllers and physical interfaces; PCI Express, universal accelerator and compute express links, and multiple memory interfaces; and Tensilica, a digital signal processor. In addition, the company's design IP portfolio includes serializer/deserializer, peripheral component interconnect, USB, and other standard protocols; and Secure-IC, a solution for embedded security IP. Additionally, it provides System Design and Analysis (SD&A) platform, a solution that enables end-to-end system-level design and verification across chips, packages, PCBs, and electronic systems; Allegro X and Orca X platforms for PCB and advanced packaging; Sigrity X for signal and power integrity; AIR for RF design; Fidelity for computational fluid dynamics; Celsius for thermal and airflow analysis; Clarity 3D solver for electromagnetic and power electronics analysis and simulation; Integrity 3D-IC solution for 3D-IC and multi-chiplet designs; the Optimality Intelligent System Explorer, Reality digital twin, and Millennium enterprise multiphasic platforms; Allegro system design platform; and molecular modeling and simulation solutions and services. The company has a strategic collaboration with NVIDIA. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
